dialogue.content: こんにちは相談者役をさせていただきますよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello. I'll be playing the role of the client. It's a pleasure to work with you.

dialogue.content: (こんにちは、遅くなり申し訳ありません今、別の方の画面になっていて確認中でした。今から始めさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？)
dialogue.English: (Hello, I apologize for the delay. I was on another person's screen and was just getting that sorted out. May we begin now?)

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですよろしくお願いします!
dialogue.English: That's fine. Yes, let's begin!

dialogue.content: (お待たせして申し訳ありませんでした。では始めさせていただきます)
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry to have kept you waiting. Let's get started.)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です本日はご相談にきていただきありがとうございます。はじめに年齢と性別をお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: ４８歳、女性ですよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: I'm 48 years old and female. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いいたします。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: はい姑がけっこう困ったさんタイプなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, my mother-in-law tends to be rather difficult.

dialogue.content: お姑さんのご相談ですねどういったところが困っておられるか話やすいところからで結構ですのでお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see, it's about your mother-in-law. Could you tell me what you find difficult about her? Please feel free to start wherever is easiest for you to talk about.

dialogue.content: はい三年前に姑の夫が亡くなって、家族葬するのに、６０万円　要求されたんです…私の夫に。
dialogue.English: Yes. Three years ago, my mother-in-law's husband passed away, and she demanded 600,000 yen for the family funeral... from my husband.

dialogue.content: 夫の弟も６０万出したらしいんですが…
dialogue.English: Apparently, my husband's younger brother also paid 600,000 yen...

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 葬式代って、亡くなった人の貯金から出さないの？って思ったんです
dialogue.English: I thought, "Aren't funeral expenses supposed to be paid from the deceased person's savings?"

dialogue.content: どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: 義理のお父様の家族葬の代金のことでお姑さんと行き違いがあったのですね、それはモヤモヤしますよね
dialogue.English: So there was a disagreement with your mother-in-law about the cost of your father-in-law's family funeral. That must be very unsettling.

dialogue.content: お姑さんからは、ご兄弟でお金を支払うことにについてはどうのようなご説明をお受けになっておりますか？
dialogue.English: What kind of explanation did your mother-in-law give you about why the brothers were to pay for it?

dialogue.content: そうなんです姑と私の夫と義弟の３人で話してるだけなので、葬式前に、姑に会ったんですが、私になんのひと言も無いんです相談員さんならどう思いますか？
dialogue.English: That's just it. She only spoke about it with my husband and his brother. I met my mother-in-law before the funeral, but she didn't say a single word to me about it. What would you think if you were in my shoes?

dialogue.content: なるほど、説明がないままお金の負担をしなければならなかったのは、お嫁さんの立場からすると不思議に思われても仕方無い状況だと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. Having to bear the financial burden without any explanation... I think it's completely understandable that you would find that strange from your position as her daughter-in-law.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…で、その後の続きがあるんですが、
dialogue.English: Right? ... And there's more that happened after that.

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 半年前の正月のことなんですが、
dialogue.English: It was during the New Year's holiday, about six months ago.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 主人と息子の二人だけで、姑の家に行ったんですが、
dialogue.English: My husband and son went to my mother-in-law's house by themselves, and...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 秋に給湯器が故障して、
dialogue.English: Her water heater broke in the fall,

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: コロナ禍で半導体不足とかの理由で、
dialogue.English: and because of the semiconductor shortage during the COVID-19 pandemic and other reasons,

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 正当な価格で給湯器交換ができなくて、
dialogue.English: she couldn't get the water heater replaced at a reasonable price.

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: とりあえず、銭湯通いなんだそうですが、
dialogue.English: So for now, she's apparently been going to the public bathhouse.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 姑が夫に、「給湯器高すぎるから買えない」とか、
dialogue.English: My mother-in-law said things to my husband like, "The water heaters are too expensive, I can't buy one."

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 言うので、夫が帰宅してから、私に給湯器代出してあげようかな…とか言うんです
dialogue.English: So when my husband came home, he said to me, "Maybe we should pay for her water heater..."

dialogue.content: たぶん、３０〜４０万くらい…
dialogue.English: It's probably around 300,000 to 400,000 yen...

dialogue.content: どう思います？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: なるほど、お姑さんは息子さん(ご主人)に金銭的に頼っている状態なんですね家族葬の事や給湯器の代金のことなど、ご主人の提案にあなたはどのようなお気持ちでいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: I see. So your mother-in-law is financially dependent on her son, your husband. How do you feel about your husband's suggestions regarding the funeral and the water heater costs?

dialogue.content: もちろん、困ります…普通のサラリーマン家庭で、住宅ローンやこれから息子の大学費用もかかるのに…
dialogue.English: Of course, it's a problem for us... We're an ordinary salaried household with a mortgage, and our son's university expenses are coming up...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、金額も大きいですし、困ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I understand. The amounts are quite large, so it's natural to be concerned.

dialogue.content: 私は、コロナ禍入って、どうなるかわからないから、給湯器早めに交換したんですもっと、年齢高いんだから、予想してほしいです
dialogue.English: I had our water heater replaced early on because, with the pandemic, I didn't know what might happen. She's older, so I wish she would anticipate these things.

dialogue.content: なるほど、先を見据えて計画的にお金を使う予定を考えておられるのですねやりくり上手くやっておられてすばらしいですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you think ahead and plan your finances carefully. It's wonderful that you manage your household budget so well.

dialogue.content: お葬式代金を出した時は、ご主人からはどういう事情で出すことになったかなど、あなたにお話はありましたか？
dialogue.English: When the funeral expenses were paid, did your husband explain the circumstances under which he ended up paying?

dialogue.content: 夫自身もはっきりと聞いてないらしく、
dialogue.English: Apparently, my husband himself didn't get a clear explanation either.

dialogue.content: 長い闘病で、病院代をまだ払ってないとか、
dialogue.English: Something about how there were still unpaid hospital bills from the long illness,

dialogue.content: でもその一年前に空き地を売って、お金はあるはずなんですよ
dialogue.English: but a year before that, they sold a vacant lot, so she should have money.

dialogue.content: 土地６０坪ですから、
dialogue.English: it was about 60 tsubo of land, roughly 200 square meters,

dialogue.content: 夫は気が弱くて、はっきりと聞けないみたいです
dialogue.English: My husband is a bit timid, so it seems he can't ask her directly.

dialogue.content: 自分の母親なのに。
dialogue.English: Even though it's his own mother.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね、お金があるはずだけれど、なぜかはハッキリとご主人は理由を聞けないのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So even though she should have money, your husband isn't able to get a clear reason as to why she needs it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですで、その後、
dialogue.English: Exactly. And after that,

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私が葬式代の時は何もあえて言わなかったけど、
dialogue.English: I chose not to say anything at the time about the funeral expenses,

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: さすがに、給湯器代は、
dialogue.English: but when it came to the water heater,

dialogue.content: 舅の土地代や保険金などがあるはずだから、自分で払ってもらうべきだと、
dialogue.English: I told him that she should have money from my father-in-law's land sale and insurance, so she should pay for it herself.

dialogue.content: 遺産相続もいっさいなかったし、
dialogue.English: We didn't receive any inheritance at all, either.

dialogue.content: なるほど、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: おかしいと思いませんか？
dialogue.English: Don't you think that's strange?

dialogue.content: そういうことがあったんですねなるほど、それはあなたがおかしいとお思いになるのも自然かなと思います。
dialogue.English: I see what happened. Yes, I think it's quite natural for you to feel that something is strange about that situation.

dialogue.content: そうですよねインターネットで調べたら、そういう姑っているらしいですけど、まさかうちもそうなるとは、びっくりしてます
dialogue.English: Right? I looked it up online, and apparently, there are mothers-in-law like that, but I'm shocked that ours would become one of them.

dialogue.content: お姑さんはお金がないわけではないのに、遺産相続も子どもたちにしないままお葬式代、給湯器代とご主人に負担してもらおうと思っているところがおかしいと納得できない状況で今回はご相談に来られてたのですね
dialogue.English: Your mother-in-law isn't short of money, yet she's not passing on any inheritance to her children and is trying to have your husband cover the funeral and water heater costs. That's the situation you find unacceptable, and that's why you came for a consultation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それはお姑さんに不信感を感じてしまいますよね
dialogue.English: That would understandably lead you to feel distrustful of your mother-in-law.

dialogue.content: そうなんですで、またその後、
dialogue.English: Exactly. And then, there's more.

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 最近、姑の末期ガンが発覚したので、
dialogue.English: Recently, my mother-in-law was diagnosed with terminal cancer.

dialogue.content: ああ、それは大変ですね、、
dialogue.English: Oh, that must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: さすがに、夫にいくら貯金あるのかきちんと話すようにと伝えたんです
dialogue.English: So I told my husband that he really needed to talk to her properly and find out how much savings she has.

dialogue.content: 帰宅した夫から聞いた話では、
dialogue.English: According to what my husband told me when he got home,

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: きちんと銀行にいくらあるのか、いっさいわからないって言うんです
dialogue.English: she says she has no idea how much money is in her bank account.

dialogue.content: 姑が自分のお金を把握してないんです
dialogue.English: My mother-in-law doesn't know the state of her own finances.

dialogue.content: どう思われます？
dialogue.English: What do you make of that?

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそれはご自分の貯金やお金の管理ができなくなっている状況ということもありえますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is it possible that she's in a state where she's no longer able to manage her own savings and money?

dialogue.content: 自己管理できてないと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think she's capable of managing herself.

dialogue.content: 何かと依存タイプですし、
dialogue.English: She's the dependent type in many ways.

dialogue.content: 舅に依存してました
dialogue.English: She was dependent on my father-in-law.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね、高齢であることやお一人暮らしが始まって、依存傾向だったことに加えて、ご自分の管理が難しくなっているのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So, in addition to her age, her dependent tendencies, and starting to live alone after her husband passed, it has become difficult for her to manage things on her own.

dialogue.content: いえ、義弟と二人暮しです
dialogue.English: No, she lives with my brother-in-law.

dialogue.content: 失礼しました。お二人暮らしなのですね
dialogue.English: My apologies. I see, they live together.

dialogue.content: 義弟とは、次男ですね
dialogue.English: By brother-in-law, I mean the second son.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まぁ、これから弟がお金の管理するんでしょうがね
dialogue.English: Well, I suppose his younger brother will manage her finances from now on.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、お母さんのご病気が進行していくことも考えられますし、弟さんとご主人お二人でお金のことだけで無く治療法なども考えることがあると思います
dialogue.English: I see. It's likely that your mother's illness will progress, and I imagine your husband and his brother will have to discuss not just money, but also treatment options.

dialogue.content: 私が夫に言って、やっといろいろ話すようになったみたいですが、
dialogue.English: It seems they've finally started talking about various things, but only after I said something to my husband.

dialogue.content: 男兄弟って、こんなもんなんですかね？
dialogue.English: Are brothers usually like this?

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、性格にもよるとは思いますが、そういうご兄弟もいらっしゃるとは思います。あなたが間に入っておられることで、ご主人も具体的にやらないといけないことが明確になることがあるかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Is that so? I'm sure it depends on their personalities, but I do think some brothers are like that. With you stepping in, it might be helping your husband see more clearly what specifically needs to be done.

dialogue.content: そうみたいですね先が思いやられますが…
dialogue.English: It seems so. The future seems daunting, though...

dialogue.content: あなたもご自分のご家庭とご主人のご実家のことと両方抱えるととても大変だと思いますが、気付いたことはご主人にお伝えして差し上げると早めの対応など、ご兄弟で考えて行かれるかもしれません
dialogue.English: I imagine it's very difficult for you to handle matters for both your own family and your husband's family. But by sharing what you've noticed with your husband, it might encourage the brothers to think about how to respond more quickly.

dialogue.content: そうですね自分がそういうことに気が回るタイプでよかったです
dialogue.English: That's true. I'm glad I'm the type of person who notices these things.

dialogue.content: 今日はお話聴いていただけて、少し発散できました
dialogue.English: I feel like I was able to let off some steam today by having you listen to me.

dialogue.content: あなたの気遣いでご主人は助かっておられるかもしれませんよただあなたの出来る範囲であくまでもご無理なさらないようにしてください
dialogue.English: Your attentiveness might be a great help to your husband. However, please make sure you don't overextend yourself and only do what is within your capacity.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はお時間になりましたが、お話されたいことは話せましたでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Our time is up for today. Were you able to talk about everything you wanted to discuss?

dialogue.content: はいムカムカしてたことが話せました！まわりに話せる人がいないので…恥かしい話だし…
dialogue.English: Yes, I was able to talk about what's been frustrating me! I don't have anyone I can talk to about this... it's kind of an embarrassing topic...

dialogue.content: それはよかったですまた何かございましたらご相談にお越しください本日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. Please feel free to come back if anything else comes up. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: では失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Then I will let you go. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。終了お願いします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work. Please end the session.)

dialogue.content: (今日はスタートが遅れて大変申し訳ありませんでした後ほど評価を宜しくお願いいたします)
dialogue.English: (I sincerely apologize again for the late start today. I would appreciate it if you could leave a review later.)
